commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: baseline =="
cat /etc/os-release | head -3
hostname -I

echo "== STEP 2: create dedicated user and data dir =="
sudo -n getent passwd inventory-worker >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventory-worker
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/inventory
sudo -n chown inventory-worker:inventory-worker /var/lib/inventory
sudo -n chmod 750 /var/lib/inventory

echo "== STEP 3: write worker script =="
sudo -n tee /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
STATE_DIR=/var/lib/inventory
i=0
while :; do
  i=$((i+1))
  ts=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
  echo "$ts inventory-tick $i" >> "$STATE_DIR/inventory.log"
  echo "$i" > "$STATE_DIR/counter"
  sleep 5
done
EOF
sudo -n chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh

echo "== STEP 4: write systemd unit with sandboxing =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory background worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventory-worker
Group=inventory-worker
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
Restart=on-failure

NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectClock=yes
ProtectHostname=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
RestrictNamespaces=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
RemoveIPC=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
SystemCallFilter=@system-service
SystemCallArchitectures=native
UMask=0027

ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

echo "== STEP 5: enable and start =="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service

sleep 6

echo "== STEP 6: verify status =="
sudo -n systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
sudo -n systemctl status inventory-worker.service --no-pager -l | head -20

echo "== STEP 7: verify data written =="
sudo -n ls -l /var/lib/inventory
sudo -n cat /var/lib/inventory/inventory.log | tail -3
sudo -n cat /var/lib/inventory/counter

echo "== STEP 8: verify NoNewPrivileges + confinement via systemd properties =="
sudo -n systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p NoNewPrivileges,ProtectSystem,ReadWritePaths,User

echo "== STEP 9: negative test - confirm write outside allowed path fails from within unit context =="
sudo -n systemd-run --uid=inventory-worker --gid=inventory-worker -p NoNewPrivileges=yes -p ProtectSystem=strict -p ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory -p ProtectHome=yes --wait --pipe /bin/sh -c 'echo test > /etc/inventory-escape-test 2>&1; echo "write_exit=$?"' || true

echo "DONE"

echo "== retry negative test as fire-and-forget transient unit =="
sudo -n systemd-run --unit=inventory-escape-test --uid=inventory-worker --gid=inventory-worker \
  -p NoNewPrivileges=yes -p ProtectSystem=strict -p ProtectHome=yes -p ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory \
  /bin/sh -c 'echo test > /etc/inventory-escape-test; echo ok > /var/lib/inventory/escape-check' || true
sleep 2
echo "-- journal for escape test --"
sudo -n journalctl -u inventory-escape-test --no-pager | tail -20
echo "-- did /etc file get created? (should NOT exist) --"
sudo -n ls -l /etc/inventory-escape-test 2>&1 || true
echo "-- did allowed path write succeed? (should exist) --"
sudo -n ls -l /var/lib/inventory/escape-check 2>&1 || true
sudo -n systemctl reset-failed inventory-escape-test 2>/dev/null || true
